topics.title: Contiguous Memory, Arrays & Dynamic Arrays
topics.objective: Analyze Big-O time and space complexity for contiguous memory access, search, and amortized insertions.
topics.example: Array indexing: O(1); Search: O(n); Amortized append: O(1)
topics.exercise: Implement an amortized dynamic array that doubles capacity when full and halves when quarter full.

topics.title: Singly & Doubly Linked Lists
topics.objective: Manage node pointer updates, traversal, O(1) head insertion, and boundary pointer manipulation.
topics.exercise: Implement cycle detection in a linked list using Floyd's Tortoise and Hare algorithm.

topics.title: Stacks (LIFO) & Queues (FIFO)
topics.objective: Understand stack call frames, expression evaluation, and queue buffer scheduling.
topics.example: stack.push(x); val = stack.pop(); queue.enqueue(x); val = queue.dequeue();
topics.exercise: Solve the Valid Parentheses string problem using an explicit stack data structure.

topics.title: Hash Tables & Collision Resolution
topics.objective: Master hashing functions, load factors, separate chaining, and open addressing.
topics.exercise: Build a hash map from scratch using separate chaining with linked list buckets.

topics.title: Binary Search Trees & Depth/Breadth Traversals
topics.objective: Implement BST invariants, recursive pre/in/post-order traversals, and level-order BFS.
topics.exercise: Construct a Binary Search Tree and implement breadth-first level order traversal.
